sprites.name: part.fin
sprites.note: MOVABLE FIN poses, left-hand: a swept blade on its orange pivot pin, from full deflection one way (frame 0, tucked down the casing) through neutral (the middle frame, a 45-degree diagonal) to the other (the last frame, flared out). Flight shows the pose of the fin's deflection, the workshop neutral; the right hand mirrors the opposite pose. Any odd number of poses works.

sprites.name: part.fin.edges
sprites.note: MOVABLE FIN root fitting per join mask, drawn over the blade: an actuator and hinge rail where the root (right) side meets no fin (the casing), a boom along the top where the left side joins another fin cell. Nothing outlines the blade.
